action_items: (Optional, from iter29) De-duplicate success toast in HierarchicalSubs gift flow — still open.
(Optional, behavioural) _build_gift_email and send-gift use discount=20 default but when user passes discount=0 or missing, email still shows '0%'; consider fallback if discount is falsy.

(Optional) bulk-renewal/send when count=0 & button is not disabled: verified `hs-bulk-send-btn` has no cursor-not-allowed class even at count=0 — button IS clickable at 0. Backend gracefully returns sent=0, so no harm, but UX could disable to prevent no-op clicks. critical_code_review_comments: superadmin.py::send_bulk_renewal — no idempotency: if admin double-clicks send, duplicate RENEW-* coupons are created per user. Consider: dedup within last N minutes or pass a request_id. Low risk as each coupon has unique random code and max_uses=1.

superadmin.py::send_bulk_renewal — discount is clamped to [1,90] but message/user_ids are not validated as list; if a client sends user_ids='x' (string), Python `for uid in 'x'` iterates chars silently. Add: `if not isinstance(user_ids, list): raise 400`.

superadmin.py::preview_bulk_renewal — iterates up to 5000 user_subscriptions client-side with per-target db.users.find_one (N+1 query pattern). For scale, use `$match` + `$lookup` in aggregation. Fine at current 15-user scale.
superadmin.py::_build_gift_email — APP_URL is used inline; ensure APP_URL env var is set in backend .env otherwise link will be broken (not tested here since SMTP may not deliver in dev).

HierarchicalSubs.js hs-bulk-send-btn — missing `disabled` attribute when bulkPreview?.count === 0. The review_request spec says: 'If count=0, button should be disabled (cursor-not-allowed class present)'. Current impl renders `(0)` text but button remains clickable with full styling. Minor UX gap.
superadmin.py::get_compound_full_details — `incidents_open` is computed but not returned in response stats → dead code (or missing from stats dict). Verify intent.
